data.one_liner: OpenStreetMap plugin for Flutter with native Android, iOS, macOS and Web support
data.what_it_does: Provides a Map widget that displays OpenStreetMap tiles and supports markers, routes, shapes and address search. It exposes a MapController for imperative control and event streams for reactive updates.
use_when: You need a fully native map widget with OSM tiles
You require routing, distance calculation or address suggestions
You want to customize markers, tiles or draw roads and shapes
avoid_when: You only need a simple static map image
Your project targets very low Android API levels (<26)
You prefer a pure Dart map implementation without native dependencies
strengths: Native performance across Android, iOS, macOS and Web
Supports vector tiles, satellite and custom tile layers
Built-in routing, distance, duration and address suggestion APIs
Declarative widget API with imperative MapController
weaknesses: High minimum Android API (26) and iOS 15.6, macOS 12.0
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, run `flutter pub get`. For Android, ensure minSdk 26, compileSdk 37, AGP 9.3.1+, Gradle 9.5.0+. iOS uses Swift Package Manager; macOS requires SPM. Permissions for location are handled via permission_handler. No build_runner needed.
